visualReview.notes: Würzburg Residence complete connected palace exterior on its actual relation outline: open western Ehrenhof and four fully open mapped inner courtyards; long sandstone garden range with central taller pavilion, steep slate roofs and two curved outer roof masses, western wing-end pediments, repeated three-level glazing/cornices, triple western and garden entrances, physical front columns and recessed side colonnades. Low dormers, balustrades, restrained original abstract roof figures and small verdigris turret carry the photographed identity. Gardens/fountain, separate town buildings and interiors remain outside this building model. No copied sculpture, frescoes, text or interior decoration. Inspected52 current frames. Complete four-court palace/forecourt and curved roof envelopes remain open at the correct mapped locations. Six physically recessed western/garden portals have closed thresholds and curved soffits; four front shafts and two six-column side loggias have real depth, floors and supporting ceilings. Three tall western arched upper windows, oval upper windows, pilasters, cornices, dormers, slate roof subdivisions and simplified original roof figures/turret give the picture-led identity. Early views led to a darker shared-slate tint and additional upper oval/pilaster geometry before the final full matrix.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Six roles share six existing256px graphs: stone_sandstone, stone_limestone, slate, storefront, wood_plain and metal_painted. Six textured draws/one skyline, canonical metric UVs, linear tints and graph means baked for skyline. No embedded images, private atlas or new graph. Separate POSITION/NORMAL streams and equal CPU/GPU geometry bytes. Each used graph reads once and unload disposes all model geometry. Flat review planes partly bury grade-specific foundations/apron; actual original native ground establishes approximate fit.

mediumFiReview.notes: Four authored LODs 763 / 3761 / 8788 / 10080 triangles; initial skyline+district geometry 394764 bytes, closeup 859776 bytes. Six GLBs zero Khronos errors/warnings;299 actual mesh/contact probes;3 PMTiles13/14/15 cases including the one detailed parent.52 current inspected frames. Skyline keeps the complete court/forecourt and roof envelope while omitting nearby fenestration/colonnade details; district adds those details within4000 triangles, closeup adds window bars, dormers, ovals/pilasters and roof abstractions. All LODs/failure/unload retain1704 resident/2307 wider independent buildings, original201x201/6m terrain/roads and1915.364m² water. Failure retains all1705 originals; clean unload restores ground/water and releases geometry. Some long-facade details crop outer edges, and arbitrary synthetic neighbors can overlap palace/court context. Turntables, full custom-LOD and native views cover the complete envelope; flat synthetic contexts are style checks, not placement evidence.
